name: Toono Nozomi
source:
A poor student who spends her days working part-time to pay for her scholarship. She is short but is a senior.

She is often misunderstood as a cool person because of her quiet tone and her calm appearance. She is actually a very emotional ordinary girl who just can't express herself well.
Her hobby is saving money, and it seems that her target amount of 1 million yen is just around the corner. Her favorite food is bread ears.

She has both adultness and girlishness, and her dream for the future is a civil servant or a bride. She cares a little about her poorly growing body, especially her small breasts complex.
Because of her innocent personality, she can't realize her love for the protagonist

"... Bread ears, do you eat?"
